legal.privacyS1Body: Your personal data is processed by What's Inside? as the data controller, in accordance with KVKK Law No. 6698, for the purposes stated below.
legal.privacyS2Body: Email address, device information, usage statistics and profile preferences (audience selection).
legal.privacyS3Body: Account management, providing analysis services, personalized warnings and subscription operations.
legal.privacyS4Body: May be shared with service providers such as cloud infrastructure and payment processors within the scope of legal obligations.
legal.privacyS5Body: You may exercise your rights of access, correction, deletion and objection under Article 11 of KVKK.
legal.termsS1Body: The application is an informational tool that analyzes product contents; it does not constitute medical advice.
legal.termsS2Body: By using the application, you agree to these terms. It may only be used for personal purposes.
legal.termsS3Body: Pro subscription is billed monthly or annually; it renews unless cancelled 24 hours before the end of the period.
legal.termsS4Body: Expert opinion must be sought for health decisions.
legal.termsS5Body: Terms may be updated; updates take effect immediately upon publication.
